panels.description: Total latency for a models LLM API call

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (model, le) (rate(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (model, le) (rate(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (model, le) (rate(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))
